notes.title: Update to 1.1
notes.notes:
The following bugs were fixed in the new update:
- The disappearance of the hose in the garage
- The disappearance of the screwdriver in the yard of the house
- Cleaning inventory from excess items after the factory.
- At the location with the garages, the puzzle with the catapult has been fixed. Now the snow does not interfere with the functioning of the puzzle.
- and other minor bugs.

WARNING!!!   When you update the game, your saves may be deleted. However, you can copy your saves manually from here:

C:/Users/[user name]/AppData/LocalLow/Anate Studio/TheSafePlace
